I am a Research Scientist at Equmenopolis, Inc. and a Guest Research Associate Professor at Perceptual Computing Laboratory at Waseda University. 

My research focuses on the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in second language speech and writing. Particularly, in recent studies, I explore how conversational AI agents can help augment assessment of Interactional Competence, the ability to co-construct oral interactions. I combine both conversational analysis and psychometric methods to tease apart what AI can (or cannot) assess human interaction.

At Equmenopolis, Inc. I oversee validation research of AI-mediated L2 oral proficiency assessment, using Intelligent Language Learning Assistant (InteLLA).

At Waseda University, I supervise (or have supervised) engineering BA, MA, and Ph.D. students, whose work combines Natural Language Processing and Language Assessment.
